Elena,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Good catch on the legacy name 'Blue Foundry Inc.' 9\u2014 we need consistency between legal name and tax records to avoid PO/ERP mapping delays.

What we need from you to finish the vendor master create and map PO routing:
1) Signed W-9 (if the vendor is US tax resident) or W-8BEN-E if foreign. You attached a W-9 draft; please sign it and re-send.
2) Bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account number and routing number (a scanned PDF with bank stamp is fine). If your bank can provide an ACH authorization letter that speeds our banking team validation.
3) Confirmation of the legal entity as it appears on the Certificate of Formation and the IRS correspondence (matching spelling and punctuation).
4) AP contact for invoice escalation vs PO receipt. We ask for: name, title, email, phone, and preferred invoice format (PDF/email or EDI).

Operational notes and next steps:
- DocuSign packet: we sent a vendor packet for electronic signature (link below). Please complete the signatory step for the legal authorized signer.
- PO routing string: our ERP requires the vendor legal name + remit method + AP email as a minimum (example: \"BlueFoundry LLC | ACH | ap@bluefoundry.com\"). If you want ACH details masked in the system, we can store banking details in secure notes but the routing string must be explicit for PO processing.
- Timeline: once we have signed W-9, bank letter, and signed DocuSign packet, Finance typically completes setup within 3 business days assuming no EIN mismatch. If we detect a name/EIN mismatch, Finance will request IRS documentation which can add 5-7 business days.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/link/ABC1234def

Let me know if BlueFoundry needs a purchase order template or sample invoice format to match our AP ingestion. I cc'd Marissa (Finance Ops) to expedite verification and Ben (Procurement) to confirm PO routing tags.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

- AP contact for PO routing: Maria Alvarez, Senior AP Specialist, ap@bluefoundry.com, +1 415-555-0199. Preferred invoice format: PDF emailed to ap@bluefoundry.com.
